title: S080 6.4.4.3 Refusing to Save Search Results
parent_path: S080 6.4.4.3 Refusing to Save Search Results

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In some cases, the server MAY refuse to save a SEARCH (SAVE) result, for example, if an internal limit on the number of saved results is reached.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In this case, the server MUST return a tagged NO response containing the NOTSAVED response code and set the search result variable to the empty sequence, as described in Section 6.4.4.1.
actions: return tagged NO response containing NOTSAVED response code
set search result variable to empty sequence
